title: Kernel sheaves of units modulo nilradical powers
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $N$ its nilradical ideal sheaf [def-weil-pbc-scheme-reduction]. For $j\geq0$, put $i_j:V(N^{j+1})\to X$, the closed subscheme defined by the indicated ideal power. Define $E_j=\ker(\mathbf G_{m,X}\to (i_j)_*\mathbf G_{m,V(N^{j+1})})$ in abelian sheaves on the small etale site [def-sc-gm-torsor, def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. The map is restriction of units along base change. Thus $E_j$ is an actual categorical kernel, with no filtration chosen from an existence theorem.
